import os
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt = Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/selfdev-20261007")
expected_head = "f108fa2765a922f800c9cc87e99eab11b629839e"

def run(args, check=True, env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args, cwd=wt, text=True, capture_output=True, check=check, env=env)

head = run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()
branch = run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()
if head != expected_head or branch != "feat/self-dogfood-20261007":
    raise SystemExit(f"unexpected isolated state head={head} branch={branch}")

test = wt / "tests/test_cli.py"
text = test.read_text()
old = '            self.assertIn("SETUP_OK", text)\n'
new = (
    '            self.assertIn("SETUP_CONFIGURED", text)\n'
    '            self.assertIn("verification=not_run", text)\n'
    '            self.assertNotIn("SETUP_OK", text)\n'
)
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("stale SETUP_OK assertion not found")
test.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))

env = os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"] = str(wt / "src")

focused = run(["python3","-m","unittest","tests.test_cli"], check=False, env=env)
print("=== focused stdout ===")
print(focused.stdout)
print("=== focused stderr ===")
print(focused.stderr)
print(f"focused_rc={focused.returncode}")
if focused.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(focused.returncode)

run(["git","add","src/do_again/cli.py","tests/test_cli.py"])
commit = run(["git","commit","-m","Stop reporting unverified setup as ready"], check=False)
print("=== commit stdout ===")
print(commit.stdout)
print("=== commit stderr ===")
print(commit.stderr)
if commit.returncode != 0:
    raise SystemExit(commit.returncode)

print("new_head=" + run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after=" + repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
